Important logic: Show grouped patient links → flag completed unread reports. Attempt logout → open login even on failure; response status is not checked.
Confirm a patient profile ID through /auth/me → load data → edit name, blood group and emergency contact. Identity fields stay read-only.

Important feature: Save profile and avoid duplicate writes
Important logic: Block another profile save with a ref → wait for confirmed response → replace cache and exit editing. Failure keeps the form open.
Accept JPEG/PNG/WEBP up to 2 MB → upload as photo → update profile cache on success.
Render the saved patient QR ID; show unavailable when missing. Backend checks who may use it.
Require a name → save selected allergy severity or condition priority flag. Severe allergies sort first; priority is chosen by the patient.

Important feature: Devices, past events and family history
Important logic: Require device name, event title or family condition → save details and chosen emergency flag → refresh that list. Family history collects a relationship, not a relative name.
Choose an entry → confirm in its dialog → send removal → refresh only the affected list on success. Failure shows an error.
Scan image → review editable extracted rows; scanning does not save. Ignore blank rows → require name and date on every active row → submit together.
Edit Mode + loaded settings → block overlapping writes → save full category list separately. Cancel profile editing does not undo saved locks; backend filtering uses record text matching.
Send appointment ID and patient code → require a confirmed grant, category list and valid expiry. The legacy role argument grants no access.
Submit trimmed specialty/hospital filters → query that filter pair → choose a doctor → open booking. Typing alone does not change applied filters.
Group displayed slots by date → select time → request OPD booking. Backend locks the doctor row, rechecks slots/conflicts and inserts in one transaction; stale requests are rejected.
Book replacement first → cancel original. Failed new booking keeps original; failed cancellation keeps replacement and may leave both active, with a warning.
Upcoming means scheduled/confirmed/in-progress by status, sorted earliest first. Other statuses form History. Only scheduled cards offer cancel/reschedule; cancellation asks for confirmation.
Require session profile ID → load records → newest first → filter by type. Counts use all records; open details only if the selected record is still returned.

Detect image extension after stripping query/fragment → preview images here; attempt new tab for other files. Mark unread reports read → refresh shared query after success. A blocked popup is not detected.
Valid expiry before browser time overrides saved status. QR needs active/partially-filled status and a reference. Progress is dispensed ÷ prescribed, limited to 0–100%; backend authorizes dispensing.

Important feature: Doctor QR lookup and access limits
Important logic: Load scanned patient identity → request health lists. Current doctor calls omit required appointment ID, so backend can reject them; some failed list requests look empty.
Doctor-only button requests immediate OPD booking → backend resolves doctor profile from session and may reuse today’s active visit → require returned ID → open consultation.
Request summary → display response or failure. Current call omits consultation ID; current formatter splits into characters, so line/table formatting is unreliable.
Keep last article for each exact title in memory → rank allergy keyword matches first → show only image articles. Conditions are not used; failures become an empty feed.
Rotate multiple articles every 15 seconds while unpaused → hover/focus pauses → arrows, dots and swipes select slides.

Ignore blank or loading sends → send new text, chosen language and previous local messages → append reply or failure → release loading. Closing keeps local history; Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

Important feature: AI chat presentation and safety notice
Important logic: Switch English/Sinhala for later requests → render reply Markdown → keep safety guidance visible. Full screen and close buttons change local display state.
Display server order status through placed → accepted → packed → out for delivery → delivered. Cancelled shows an alert; unknown statuses mark no step reached. This page does not update orders.
Load patient transactions → show returned success/pending/failed status → open selected receipt and amount. Sandbox notice stays visible; the page makes no charge request.
Send QR reference → return the complete response envelope. Backend checks access and validity; this request does not dispense medicine.
